fusions.name: Thrown Wake
fusions.desc: Throws your wake across a cone 2.5 tiles long. It deals 3 damage and leaves each enemy [Soaked] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Line Astern
fusions.desc: Sends a brood out in single file. It deals 12 damage to the first enemy in its path, then follows on to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Shallow Draught

riders.text: you cross it 12% faster than ground
your stamina recovers 20% faster on it
your dodge chance rises by 8% on it

fusions.desc: You cross water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
